Bengaluru daycare abuse case, West Bengal protests dominate Indian news

Multiple Indian news outlets covered two distinct events: the arrest of a whistleblower in a Bengaluru daycare abuse case and protests in West Bengal. In Bengaluru, police defended the arrest of a whistleblower, stating she was an "equal party" to the abuse. Meanwhile, in West Bengal, a court cleared a Trinamool rally protesting alleged brutality, while Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee accused police of acting like "BJP cadres" and hindering protests.

How outlets across the spectrum covered it

  • Left (4): National Herald, The Hindu, The News Minute, The Telegraph (India)
  • Centre (7): Mathrubhumi English, NDTV, The Free Press Journal, The New Indian Express, The Print, The Times of India, The Tribune
  • Right (2): Swarajya, The Pioneer
